title: Droplet Open Cuff
descriptionHtml:
Two endings, one round, one falling. A slim polished open cuff that finishes in two different shapes: a round ball on one end and a smooth teardrop on the other, sitting across a small gap. Matches our Droplet Open Ring, so the two can be worn as a pair.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with the Droplet Open Ring in the same metal.

Details

  • Style: Slim open cuff
  • Wire: Approximately 3mm, polished
  • Ends: A round ball, approximately 9mm, and a smooth teardrop
  • Inner width: Approximately 6cm
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated or rhodium plated silver tone (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
